column1: # Expectations for the hand-written half of testdata/refblocks/invalid/.
# One row per flat fixture: its name without ".fol", a tab, and text the FIRST
# diagnostic must contain. These files are written by hand for rules no reference
# block covers, so their names are stable and can be pinned.
# The L<line>/ folders are NOT listed. Those are extracted from the reference and
# renumber whenever it is edited, so a manifest keyed by line number would churn
# on every doc change. They are covered instead by the filename-artifact guard in
# refblocks_invalid_test.go, which is what catches a fixture failing for the wrong
# reason without depending on a name that moves.
# This file survives `go run ./cmd/refblocks -write`: regeneration clears only

column2: expected text in the first diagnostic
arithmetic is not permitted in an array dimension; an index is an integer literal or a name, so write a @co.dap.const constant instead of "*"
a dependent index may not be negative, so "-" cannot appear in an array dimension; an index is a non-negative integer literal or a name
arithmetic is not permitted in a dependent-type argument; an index is an integer literal or a name, so write a @co.dap.const constant instead of "+"
